desc: The Wise Arms AWA-15B Semi-Auto Rifle with 15" M-LOK Rail is a solid platform with all the needed goodies to get you going on your next AR. The billet-machined lower features cool cuts and a deep-cut, oversized trigger guard for use with winter gloves. A 6-position stock allows for stock adjustment. An M16 bolt carrier group is the heart of the weapon and keeps the Wise Arms rifle pumping round after round. A 16" heavy-profile barrel comes with a pistol-length gas system and a standard A2 birdcage flash hider.
